cues.zh: 如果你已经对领导力和发起运动了解不少，那咱们来看
cues.en: If you've learned a lot about leadership and making a movement, then let's watch

cues.zh: 一场运动从头到尾是怎么发生的
cues.en: a movement happened start to finish

cues.zh: 不到三分钟，然后剖析几点经验
cues.en: in under three minutes and dissect some lessons

cues.zh: 领导者得有胆量独自站着，看起来像个傻瓜。
cues.en: A leader needs the guts to stand alone and look ridiculous.

cues.zh: 但他做的事其实很简单，几乎像教学示范。这很关键。
cues.en: But what he's doing is so simple, it's almost instructional. This is key.

cues.zh: 你必须让人容易跟！接着出现的是第一位跟随者，角色至关重要：
cues.en: You must be easy to follow! Now comes the first follower with a crucial role:

cues.zh: 他公开向大家示范怎么跟。注意，领导者把他当平等的人
cues.en: He publicly shows everyone how to follow. Notice the leader embraces him

cues.zh: 来接纳，所以重点不再是领导者——而是他们，是复数。
cues.en: as an equal, so it's not about the leader anymore - it's about them, plural.

cues.zh: 注意他在招呼朋友们加入
cues.en: Notice he's calling to his friends to join in

cues.zh: 当第一位跟随者需要胆量！你会很显眼
cues.en: It takes guts to be a first follower! You stand out

cues.zh: 还要勇敢面对嘲笑。做第一位跟随者是一种
cues.en: and brave ridicule, yourself. Being a first follower is an

cues.zh: 被低估的领导力形式。第一位跟随者
cues.en: under-appreciated form of leadership. The first follower

cues.zh: 把一个孤零零的疯子变成了领导者。如果领导者是打火石，
cues.en: transforms a lone nut into a leader. If the leader is the flint,

cues.zh: 第一位跟随者就是点燃火焰的那颗火星。
cues.en: the first follower is the spark that makes the fire.

cues.zh: 第二个跟随者是一个转折点：
cues.en: The 2nd follower is a turning point:

cues.zh: 这证明第一个跟随者做得很好。现在不再是一个孤立的疯子，
cues.en: it's proof the first has done well. Now it's not a lone nut,

cues.zh: 也不是两个疯子。三个人就是一群人，而一群人就是新闻。
cues.en: and it's not two nuts. Three is a crowd and a crowd is news.

cues.zh: 一场运动必须公开。确保局外人看到的不仅仅是领导者。
cues.en: A movement must be public. Make sure outsiders see more than just the leader.

cues.zh: 每个人都需要看到跟随者，因为新的跟随者会模仿跟随者——而不是领导者。
cues.en: Everyone needs to see the followers, because new followers emulate followers - not the leader.

cues.zh: 现在又来了两个，然后三个。
cues.en: Now here come 2 more, then 3 more.

cues.zh: 现在我们有了势头。这就是引爆点！现在我们有一场运动了！
cues.en: Now we've got momentum. This is the tipping point! Now we've got a movement!

cues.zh: 随着更多人加入，它不再
cues.en: As more people jump in, it's no longer

cues.zh: 有风险。如果他们之前还在犹豫，现在没有理由不加入了。
cues.en: risky. If they were on the fence before, there's no reason not to join now.

cues.zh: 他们不会被嘲笑，不会显得突兀，
cues.en: They won't be ridiculed, they won't stand out,

cues.zh: 而且如果他们抓紧的话，会成为圈内人的一部分。在接下来的一分钟里
cues.en: and they will be part of the in-crowd, if they hurry. Over the next minute

cues.zh: 你会看到其余那些更愿意成为人群一部分的人，
cues.en: you'll see the rest who prefer to be part of the crowd,

cues.zh: 因为最终他们会因为不加入而被嘲笑。
cues.en: because eventually they'd be ridiculed for not joining.

cues.zh: 女士们先生们，一场运动就是这样诞生的！我们来回顾一下学到的：
cues.en: And ladies and gentlemen that is how a movement is made! Let's recap what we learned:

cues.zh: 如果你是那个赤膊跳舞的家伙，
cues.en: If you are a version of the shirtless dancing guy,

cues.zh: 孤身一人，记住培养最初几个
cues.en: all alone, remember the importance of nurturing your first few

cues.zh: 追随者的重要性，平等对待他们，让一切都明确围绕这场运动，而不是你自己。
cues.en: followers as equals, making everything clarly about the movement, not you.

cues.zh: 要公开。要容易被追随！但最大的教训在这里……
cues.en: Be public. Be easy to follow! But the biggest lesson here...

cues.zh: ……你注意到了吗？领导力被过度美化了。
cues.en: ... did you catch it? Leadership is over-glorified.

cues.zh: 是的，一切始于那个赤膊家伙，
cues.en: Yes it started with the shirtless guy,

cues.zh: 他会得到所有功劳，但你看到了真正发生的事：
cues.en: and he'll get all the credit, but you saw what really happened:

cues.zh: 是第一个追随者把一个孤僻的疯子变成了领袖。
cues.en: It was the first follower that transformed a lone nut into a leader.

cues.zh: 没有第一个追随者就没有运动。我们总被告知都需要
cues.en: There is no movement without the first follower. We're told we all need to

cues.zh: 当领导者
cues.en: be leaders

cues.zh: 当领导者，但那其实非常低效。发起一场运动最好的方式，
cues.en: be leaders, but that would be really ineffective. The best way to make a movement,

cues.zh: 如果你真的在乎，就是勇敢地
cues.en: if you really care, is to courageously

cues.zh: 追随，并向他人展示如何追随。当你发现一个
cues.en: follow and show others how to follow. When you find a

cues.zh: 孤僻的疯子在做了不起的事，要有勇气做第一个站出来加入的人。
cues.en: lone nut doing something great, have the guts to be the first person to stand up and join in.
